candidates.change_summary: Invert the access-control condition so only non-owners may pass the modifier.
Delete the require check so the onlyOwner modifier imposes no restriction.
Withdraw a fixed amount of 1 wei instead of the whole contract balance.
Delete the withdraw call so withdrawAll performs no transfer at all.
Remove the transfer statement so withdraw(uint256) performs no ether transfer, changing the contract's balance observable after any withdraw call.
Invert the owner check so only non-owners may call guarded functions like withdraw(uint256), making previously successful withdraw calls revert and vice versa.
Remove the onlyOwner guard from sendMoney so any caller can send contract funds.
Delete the failure check so a failed call no longer reverts and the function completes without reverting.
Replace the transfer value with 0 so sendMoney always sends zero wei instead of _value.
Invert the failure check so the call reverts whenever it succeeds instead of when it fails.
Remove the withdraw call so withdrawAll sends no ether.
Withdraw 0 instead of the full contract balance.
Drop the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can withdraw the whole balance.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners pass the modifier.
Replace the transfer amount `_value` with a fixed `1` wei so the withdrawn amount differs.
Delete the transfer statement so no ether is sent at all.
Invert the require condition so only non-owners pass the modifier.
Delete the require check so anyone may call owner-guarded functions.
